title: Evidence chain (ChainEntry + SignedChainHead)
description: The tamper-evident spine that binds the certificate SET. Each ChainEntry hash-links to its predecessor; a SignedChainHead anchors the whole chain under an m-of-n governance signature with a monotonic `last_seq` (anti-rollback). Reflects framework.v2.evidence.models.ChainEntry and vigil_core.models.SignedChainHead. Both are serialized in full (model_dump(mode="json")) — the head always emits its v2 members even for a v1 head, but the v2 members are DROPPED from the head's SIGNING payload when schema_version < 2 (see SPEC.md), so a v1 head signs byte-identically to a pre-v2 head.

ChainEntry.description: One link in the spine. entry_hash = sha256(canonical_json({"cert_digest":cert_digest,"prev_hash":prev_hash,"seq":seq})).

prev_hash.description: The predecessor's entry_hash, or the genesis constant (64 zero hex chars) for the first link (or a re-based live window's base_prev_hash).

cert_digest.description: The linked certificate's cert_digest (sha256 of its canonical bytes). The chain's cert_digest sequence MUST equal the certificates' own cert_digests, in order, so none was suppressed/injected/reordered.

SignedChainHead.description: The signed anchor of the spine.

schema_version.description: 1 = no-prune head (v2 fields carry their identity defaults and are excluded from the signing payload); 2 = cold-archive/hard-prune head (v2 fields are signed).

last_seq.description: seq of the last entry; monotonic across accepted heads (anti-rollback high-water).

entry_count.description: ABSOLUTE record count = base_count + len(live window).

head_hash.description: The last entry's entry_hash (or the genesis constant for an empty chain).

cumulative_merkle_root.description: Running Merkle accumulator over all pruned leaves; "" when nothing pruned.

snapshot_seq.description: seq of the snapshot record this head commits; -1 = none.

prev_head_hash.description: sha256 of the prior accepted head's signing bytes (meta-chain); "" for a v1 head.
